version: CP-IF05 / IF-06 + P2-01, first locked run
enumeration: snapshot direct-child supported videos sorted by Unicode filename; filenames not read for decisions; no automatic watcher
A: A0 byte-exact IF05 LH_safe/Cmax replay, A1 frozen Cadd readout, A2 Cadd evidence bytes + exact Cmax time fallback, A3 analogous Cmin diagnostic. New evidence IDs can annotate time segments but cannot create or corroborate time boundaries. Scripted first bracket plus 0.5 seconds or middle third, 10fps, 8 pictures.
B_baseline: New videos have no IF05 cache: v05 coarse scale/quality/all-pair SIFT+HSV, automatic v06 frozen cores, IF04 HSV corroboration with whole-view direct witnesses and IF05 LH-safe fuse; no alternative catalog expansion. All B arms use one byte-identical direct input and old selector. Scene hypotheses and time occurrences are separate. Initial timing is provisional only, never ground truth.
B_memory: B0 off; B1 exact IF05 motion and track guards; B2 removes only the different-high-evidence-ID motion veto. All retain accepted old transition guards for motion continuity, quality, no geometry, camera motion checks and the IF05 edge tracking budget. Suspected abrupt edit = raw MAD >= .18, no geometry, no supported photometric explanation, no valid supported registration; blocks local witness neighborhoods or cross-ID windows straddling that edit.

B_association.logic: Require two verified wide-view direct matching pairs, four distinct high-confirmed occurrence frames spaced >=.6s in each time episode, no suspected-edit evidence in either witness span, comparable clear frames, same time order. Each pair must cover both image axes and >=3 quadrants on both sides in recorded inliers. Require localized travel/return evidence for no-overlap between endpoints: two intervening frames outside candidate occurrences without direct geometric support to either witness (support absence is only a diversity gate, never negative identity evidence), OR a verified IF05 direct reentry involving those two occurrence IDs. Only one conservative scene-level relation per clip, first lexicographic qualifying pair of occurrence IDs, no transitive propagation, selected as tentative same-place assignment; preserve separate time occurrences and cuts. Unknown when blocked; different IDs alone never supply a different-place conclusion. Report all B0/B1/B2 effects and abstentions.

P2.logic: P0 IF05 Cmax exact plus V/uniform; P1 adds before/after state pair reservations from stable support on both sides of persisted localized structure change or frozen contextual transition; no positional endpoint rule, annotation use, changes to recognition or selected pool. Rank wide contextual evidence and isolated structure change independently; at most three paired roles, then old picks with duplicate-aware fill and exact same 8 budget. Local windows derive from strongest pair, or old fallback, fresh 10fps each. P2 semantic optional not attempted.

stop: One prediction pass; labels sealed separately and excluded from imports; all old assets and sources read-only; preserve failures, no tune/reselect/model, no Agent experiment. B read-only directory may be overridden with --media-dir on a fresh run.
